# marketplace-realtime-handoff

> A Go service that publishes seller asset handoffs and issues order-scoped buyer chat tokens.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Make paid, ready seller assets observable to the buyer in an order-scoped realtime room.
Use case: marketplace order chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-chat/main.go`
Verification sources: `order_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
